Digital Realty reported 870 million dollars in quarterly capital expenditure for the quarter ending March 2026, the smallest figure among the eight builders tracked here and the only one in this set whose spending fell before it rose.

The series runs across four March quarters a year apart, 738.7 million in 2023, then a decline to 659.3 million in 2024, then a recovery to 787.3 million in 2025, and 870 million in 2026. That dip and recovery is a different shape from every other builder in this collection, all of which show only upward or accelerating movement across their reported quarters, and it leaves Digital Realty's most recent figure only about 18 percent above where it stood three years earlier.

Digital Realty's 870 million dollars is less than a fifteenth of Amazon's 54.2 billion and well below Equinix's 1.26 billion, the next smallest peer. No SEC filings are recorded in this dataset disclosing new financial obligations for Digital Realty, matching Microsoft's pattern of capex growth without an accompanying filing trail in this collection.
